entries.german: widerruft die von ihm dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg u. anderen gethanen Verschreibungen und Vergabungen von Gütern des Kl. Goldenkron. Ad m. d. r. domino G. episcopo Pataviensi cancellario referente Franciscus prepos. Strigon. ─ R. w. v.
entries.english: He revokes the charters and grants of property of Goldenkron Monastery that he had made to Ulrich von Rosenberg and others. By mandate of the Roman king, reported by Lord G., Bishop of Passau, chancellor; Franciscus, provost of Esztergom. King’s letter; witnessed.
